newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyoda Automatic, TI halt talks on chip firm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyoda Automatic, TI halt talks on chip firm - paper.

text.p: Toyoda Automatic Loom Works Ltd and Texas Instruments Inc have stopped negotiations on setting up a joint venture to manufacture dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips due to weak demand, a Japanese business daily reported on Thursday.
The daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the companies had been considering starting joint production of 256-megabit DRAM chips in Japan by 1999.
A spokesman for Toyoda Automatic was not immediately available to comment on the report.
Earlier this week, Hitachi Ltd, Mitsubishi Electric Corp and Texas Instruments said that they had agreed to jointly develop one-gigabit DRAM chips.
The tie-up is aimed at sharing resources and technologies for developing the next-generation chips, they said.
